notes: Mount both transducer faces level with a clear view beyond the bumper. Trigger front and rear units sequentially to limit acoustic crosstalk. Final clearance and exposure protection need review.

name: Temperature probes / waterproof DS18B20
notes: Clamp each probe to the external surface with suitable thermal contact and cable strain relief. These placements estimate surface temperatures, not cell-core or winding temperatures. Route clear of rotating parts and live conductors; leads may need extension.

name: Contact force / Interlink FSR 402
notes: Place under a small load-spreading pad with mechanical overload stops. This force-sensing resistor does not measure tire pressure, vehicle weight or crash loads. Calibrate the completed pad assembly.

custom_parameters.sensor_summary: Detects light contact at a compliant bumper pad.

notes: Fix the board to the chassis and center a correctly polarized rotating magnet over the chip, within the specified sensing gap. Prefer a steering output pivot within one revolution. A multi-turn steering column needs turn tracking or gearing. Magnet and bracket fit remain to be designed.

custom_parameters.sensor_summary: Measures the angle of the steering output pivot.
